subject: Kickoff: Supplier ESG & Diversity Questionnaire — GreenLeaf Supplies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Kickoff: Supplier ESG & Diversity Questionnaire — GreenLeaf Supplies

Hi Sienna,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. As part of our procurement intake and PO setup we run a short ESG / supplier diversity / modern slavery assessment so we can complete the vendor profile in our systems and route the first PO.

Could you please: 
- Complete the attached GreenLeaf_ESG_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (I attached a clean fillable copy you can return)
- Return a copy of any supplier diversity or minority-owned business certifications you hold (we've received a scanned certificate in the past; a JPEG/PDF is fine)
- Confirm your billing remit and the preferred PO contact (name + email + tax id or VAT where applicable)

Target timeline: if we can get completed paperwork by end of next week (Feb 24) we can do a clean onboarding and issue the initial PO the following week. If there are any questions on specific fields (e.g., scopes of emissions, subcontractor disclosure), loop me or Neha in and we can clarify.

Thanks — looking forward to getting GreenLeaf added as a supplier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thank you, and great to meet you. I attached the completed questionnaire (GreenLeaf_ESG_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) and our supplier diversity certificate (Diversity_Cert_GLS_2025.jpg). A few notes inline on the questionnaire:

- Q6 (Scope 1/2 reporting): We report annually. Our most recent calendar-year emissions are 2024, available on request; we included summary numbers in the form.
- Q9 (Modern slavery / supply chain audits): We use a risk-based third-party auditor; higher-risk tiers are audited annually and we have policies in place to cascade requirements downstream.
- Q12 (Subcontractors): We disclose major third-party manufacturers; detailed lists are redacted here for confidentiality but can be provided under an NDA.

Billing contact: Riley Schultz, AP Manager — riley.schultz@greenleaf-supplies.com; Tax ID: 12-3456789.

If Redwood requires additional evidence for any specific regulatory regime (for example, if you need an SOC2 or similar for logging access), let me know and I'll pull the appropriate packet.

Best,

Marissa / Team,

Thanks for the packet. Quick notes after a first pass: 
- The ESG questionnaire looks complete for onboarding. The redaction on subcontractor details is acceptable at intake; request full list under NDA if the contract value exceeds $250k or if Redwood will require direct audit rights.
- For PO: we do require vendor tax form (W-9) on file for US entities before issuing vendor payment; a preliminary PO (non-payment placeholder) can be created for initial provisioning, but final invoice processing will need W-9. Neha — please confirm in Coupa whether we have a standard placeholder PO workflow for vendor trials.
- Recommend adding an explicit modern slavery warranty into the master services agreement and a right-to-audit clause for higher-risk suppliers. I can draft suggested language and share a redline by EOD tomorrow.

If everyone is comfortable I'll mark the vendor as "onboarding in progress" in the procurement tracker and queue the PO placeholder.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
